name: Miriam Sinclair
original_name: ミリアム・シンクレア
source:
Though still in her 30s, she is an exceptionally talented woman who oversees the Magic Academy of Wozerburg. Although she is a kind-hearted school principal, she can also be strict at times.

A little over 10 years ago, when she was still a student, the previous president caused a certain incident that led to her becoming the sixth president. However, during that time she lost her husband, whom she had married while she was still a student, and her newborn child.
